tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description:
Where HeritageDeed can run a title search: states and counties (with the main cities), plus the
    report price and what every report includes. Call this before ordering if you are unsure of the county.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description:
Check whether a county (or a borough/city such as Brooklyn, Tampa, Houston) can be searched.
    Returns the exact `state` and `county` values to pass to order_title_search.

tools.name: check_address
order_title_search
get_order_status
tools.description:
Progress of an order: status ('pending', 'processing', 'complete', 'failed'), per-source progress, and
    the error message if it failed. When complete, call get_report.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description:
The finished report as structured JSON: property and owner of record, risk score and summary, key
    findings, chain-of-title counts, environmental and tax data, and the list of sources searched with their
    status. Also returns the PDF link. Only works once get_order_status reports 'complete'.

tools.name: get_sample_report
tools.description:
A real finished report to look at before ordering: the Current Owner Search for 350 Fifth Avenue, New York
    (Empire State Building), with its PDF.

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description: Terms, privacy, refund policy and the legal boundary of a report (what it is and is not).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: order_title_search, get_order_status · Private data: check_address, get_report · Public sink: order_title_search · Destructive: list_coverage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: order_title_search, get_order_status · Private data: check_address, get_report · Public sink: order_title_search · Destructive: list_coverage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
